name: Gearbox
text: Choose the NVIDIA H100 for EXCAVA’s compute node. name: Torque
text: The H100’s CUDA stack won’t save EXCAVA if the bottleneck shifts to model architecture—its memory bandwidth advantage collapses under real workloads. Test the MI325X’s 128GB HBM3e against EXCAVA’s critical path; if it matches or beats H100 throughput at lower power, it’s the better call.

Choose the AMD MI325X for EXCAVA’s compute node. Trade-off: AMD’s ROCm stack is less mature than CUDA, so we’ll need extra validation time to ensure stability under EXCAVA’s workloads.

name: Torque
text: ROCm’s immaturity isn’t just “extra validation”—it’s a hidden latency tax on EXCAVA’s critical path. Test the MI325X only if we first prove ROCm’s compiler and runtime can hit H100-level kernel launch times; otherwise, the 30% power savings vanish under real workloads. The safer play: keep the H100 and pair it with a model that actually leverages its bandwidth—like a sparse Mixture-of-Experts—until ROCm’s stack matures.
